body.normal: SPICe+ is the single online form the Ministry of Corporate Affairs uses to incorporate a company in India. Part A reserves the company's name: we propose up to two names and the Registrar checks they are unique and allowed.
body.simple: Part A is where we ask the government to approve your company's name.
body.detail: SPICe+ (form INC-32) has two parts. Part A is name reservation: the proposed names, the main business activity and the type of company are submitted, and the Registrar of Companies either approves a name or sends it back for changes. An approved name is held for 20 days, during which Part B (the incorporation itself) must be filed. Part A can also be filed together with Part B in one go. The details you give in Client Details feed the name application your project lead files.
body.why: Nothing else in incorporation can be filed until a name is approved, so the details you give now set the pace for the whole setup.
